meta.name: Brocade Mouse Royal Cat Nine Deep Blood Wolf
meta.description: In the silence of the night, the demonic wolf devours the moon, after which the lights of the Heavenly Pavilion go out one by one. Zhan Zhao, the "Imperial Cat", and Bai Yu Tang, the "Golden Mouse", work together to detect a series of strange deaths in Bianliang City and return the people to a peaceful life.
